stayType: Small adults-only hotel on North Walk, Lynton

overview: The Chough's Nest is a family-run dinner, bed and breakfast hotel on North Walk in Lynton. It has seven sea-view bedrooms, a garden terrace and a lounge, and takes adults and over-16s only.
surfTripFit: A coast-path and Exmoor base rather than a surf stay; no board storage is mentioned.
